items.reason: Data migration on update: every HQ call to a database part that is not there yet answers 'needs the database update' instead of breaking (gym server and Cloudflare database both), and each nightly step has its own try. Older member apps still get the newest team reply in the old single reply field. Answers default to no-store and the service worker is re-checked on every visit; the page itself has no 'new version' signal, so an open HQ tab keeps the old version (existing finding). Sideload vs Play, watch vs phone: no app package is built here (server only). The door-machine Worker is not deployed, so no installed version exists.

Trial end: the planned reminders skip trial gyms (existing). Plan end: the nightly downgrade leaves no log line and a cheaper plan only starts while online buying is on (existing). Paid-until moves on 1 or 12 months from the later of today and the old end, to the end of that India day; 31 Jan gives 28/29 Feb, a leap year handled by the database calendar. Gym paused: door punches are thrown away (existing). Member leaves: the push address is deleted and only current members are sent pop-ups; a returning member saves a new one from the app. Staff leaves: HQ has one allowed account and its 30-day sign-in cannot be ended elsewhere (existing). Owner changes phone: HQ gives a new sign-in code after a fresh sign-in. Year end: India day and month start come from the India date, the weekly check counts whole UTC days, so no year-end gap. Not opened for 6 months: HQ sign-in lasts 30 days, dead phone addresses are dropped by the sender.

New-only rules found: a desk fee request becomes a phone note only in its first 15 minutes, so a member who links the app later never gets it as a note (part of an existing finding); the missed-payment check looks only 48 hours back (existing). Help questions sent before the help columns existed still list with an empty answer.
Older apps read the newest team reply from the old field; the fee note only points to the app's pay page, which the member can open on his own.
Rule applied: no new fault beyond the existing ones.
The only 'new' mark the server makes is the 'New offer' pop-up, made once when the gym adds an offer and sent only to current members; the server makes no What's new, dots or update notices.
Rule applied: an offer is marked new only when it is added, so nothing old is marked new.
